title: One Algorithm, Two Goals: Dual Scoring for Parameter and Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2605.06166v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuning, parameter and data selection are common strategies for reducing fine-tuning cost, yet they are typically driven by separate scoring mechanisms. When a parameter mask and data subset jointly determine restricted fine-tuning, this separation incurs redundant overhead and makes coordinated selection difficult. We cast parameter and data selection as two bilevel selection problems under a common validation objective and derive a shared local response-surrogate scoring rule. Under first- and second-order validation-improvement approximations, parameter importance and data utility emerge as column-wise and row-wise aggregations of a single gradient interaction matrix, yielding a closed-form row-column correspondence for co-extracting both signals. translated_title: 一个算法，两个目标：大语言模型微调中参数与数据选择的双重评分
translated_abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）微调中，参数选择和数据选择是降低微调成本的常用策略，但它们通常由各自独立的评分机制驱动。当参数掩码和数据子集共同决定受限微调时，这种分离会带来冗余开销，并使协同选择变得困难。我们将参数选择和数据选择表述为在共同验证目标下的两个双层选择问题，并推导出一个共享的局部响应替代评分规则。在一阶和二阶验证改进近似下，参数重要性和数据效用表现为同一个梯度交互矩阵的列向聚合与行向聚合，从而得到用于协同提取这两种信号的闭式行列对应关系。基于这一结构，我们提出了DualSFT（双重选择微调），这是一种一次性双重评分算法，可生成参数掩码和数据……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出DualSFT算法，将LLM微调中的参数选择与数据选择统一为同一验证目标下的双层选择问题，通过对单一梯度交互矩阵进行行列聚合，一次性同时完成参数掩码和数据子集的双重评分与选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DualSFT, which unifies parameter and data selection in LLM fine-tuning as two bilevel selection problems under a common validation objective, using column-wise and row-wise aggregations of a single gradient interaction matrix to simultaneously score both in a one-shot dual-selection algorithm.
